## Invitations

A total of 510 invitations were issued for the East City outreach activity. Attendance was 293, giving an attendance rate of 57.5. The figures provide a clear summary of the response to the invitation process and indicate that more than half of those invited attended.

The attendance result will support review of the outreach approach and help inform future engagement activity. The invitation and attendance figures are recorded for the reporting period and should be considered alongside the contact activity outlined below.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 442 invitations. A reminder was also sent to 442 people. The matching figures indicate that SMS communication and reminder activity were applied consistently across the recorded contact group.

These contact measures formed part of the effort to support attendance and maintain engagement with invitees. Further follow-up arrangements remain part of the outreach process for people who did not attend.

Prepared by G. Evans.
